column15: {=ARM_KR_061_1_U}Rangers ride back through the gate of Castle Black at dusk with one saddle empty and no wish to talk. Beyond the Wall whole villages of the free folk stand deserted, and the men who come back swear they saw the dead walking with eyes like blue stars.
column16: {=ARM_KR_061_1_L}The Lord Commander writes to every lord and king in Westeros begging for men. Few answer. Anyone who brings captives to the Wall to take the black, the Watch says, will be thanked and remembered.

column2: {=ARM_KR_061_1_P1}Rangers at Castle Black talk of dead men walking beyond the Wall, with eyes that burn blue in the dark.

column9: {=ARM_KR_t061_D}The Night's Watch needs men against what is coming. Bring 15 captives, common soldiers rather than lords, to Castle Black to take the black.

column15: {=ARM_KR_061_2_U}Word from beyond the Wall grows worse with every raven. The dead now hold {COUNT} places in the haunted forest: burned villages, empty holdfasts and ring-forts where the snow lies unbroken by any living foot.
column16: {=ARM_KR_061_2_L}Wildlings flee south toward the Wall by the thousand, choosing the old enemy over the new. Black brothers on the ice keep fires burning all night, and even the bravest rangers no longer go out alone.

column2: {=ARM_KR_061_2_W}Ravens from the Wall: the dead now hold {COUNT} places beyond it, and the free folk are fleeing south toward the ice.

column15: tytul
column16: gora

column15: {=ARM_KR_061_3_U}From the hills north of the Wall the last rangers have seen it: a host of the dead too vast to count, filling the valleys inside a blizzard that never ends. At its head ride pale shapes on dead horses, in armour like ice, with swords that shatter steel.
column16: {=ARM_KR_061_3_L}The Long Night of the old tales is no longer a story for children. Every man who can hold a spear is needed on the Wall, while the lords of the south still quarrel over who should sit on a chair of iron.

column1: # 062 Wiara uzbrojona (nr 15 z listy 30). 130 dni po smierci Tywina, Cersei rzadzi. Frakcja faith_militant (jest w ROT) - patrol Synow Wojownika
# przy Przystani (banda z puli wyrzutkow regionu); lojalnosc i bezpieczenstwo Przystani w gore. Prowadzi do 077 (K8, kr:062.1+130).

column15: {=ARM_KR_062_1_U}The crown owes the Faith a fortune it cannot pay. Queen Cersei strikes a bargain with the new High Septon, a barefoot old man the smallfolk call the High Sparrow: the debt is forgiven, and the Faith may raise its holy orders once again.
column16: {=ARM_KR_062_1_L}Within weeks the Warrior's Sons ride armed through the city with seven-pointed stars on their shields, and the Poor Fellows walk the roads. The smallfolk cheer them, and the queen believes she has made herself a useful tool.

column2: {=ARM_KR_062_1_P1}The sparrows are everywhere in King's Landing now, and armed knights of the Faith ride beside them with stars on their shields.

column15: {=ARM_KR_063_1_U}Freys and Lannisters ring Riverrun, the last castle of the river lords that still defies the crown. Ser Jaime Lannister comes to end the siege and rides to the drawbridge himself to parley with Ser Brynden Tully, the Blackfish, who holds it for his house.
column16: {=ARM_KR_063_1_L}The old knight hears him out and refuses everything. Riverrun has food for two years, he says, and he will not yield it to oathbreakers. Jaime rides back to camp, the siege lines are dug deeper and the trebuchets are made ready.

column15: {=ARM_KR_063_1a_U}Ser Jaime Lannister brings Edmure Tully in chains before the walls of Riverrun, where the Blackfish still holds out. To Edmure alone Jaime speaks plainly: if the castle does not yield, Edmure's child, when it is born, will be sent over the walls by trebuchet.
column16: {=ARM_KR_063_1a_L}Edmure weeps and begs his uncle from the riverbank. The Blackfish will not open the gates to Lannisters, but the garrison has seen their lord in chains, and their will begins to crack. Everyone knows the siege cannot last forever.

column15: {=ARM_KR_063_1b_U}Ser Jaime Lannister threatens the unborn child of Edmure Tully, and Edmure breaks. He crosses into his own castle and commands the garrison to lower the drawbridge. Riverrun yields without a sword drawn, and lion and Frey banners rise over its walls.
column16: {=ARM_KR_063_1b_L}In the night the Blackfish slips away through the water gate and is gone downriver. House Frey takes Riverrun, and Edmure rides west in chains, a prisoner bound for Casterly Rock.

column1: # 064 Brienne na Cichej Wyspie. Za m17 (Brienne wedruje) i m07 (Podrick); wariant a bez Podricka. Rorge i Gendry - sam tekst.
# 064.2 wariant a: Ogar nie zniknal (m11 nie wykonany) - bez grabarza. 064.3: Brienne ranna 25 dni; prowadzi do 047.2 (K4) przez 070.2.

column15: {=ARM_KR_064_1_U}Brienne of Tarth and young Podrick Payne search the burned Riverlands for a lost Stark girl. They fall in with a barefoot septon walking his rounds with a big dog, and on the road he tells them how war breaks simple men.
column16: {=ARM_KR_064_1_L}Most outlaws were farm boys once, the septon says. Sent to war with songs, they saw horrors, lost their lords and their gods, and stopped being men at all. Brienne looks at the bodies hanging from the trees and keeps her hand on her sword.

column15: {=ARM_KR_064_1a_U}Brienne of Tarth searches the burned Riverlands alone for a lost Stark girl. She falls in with a barefoot septon walking his rounds with a big dog, and on the road he tells her how war breaks simple men.
column16: {=ARM_KR_064_1a_L}Most outlaws were farm boys once, the septon says. Sent to war with songs, they saw horrors, lost their lords and their gods, and stopped being men at all. Brienne looks at the bodies hanging from the trees and keeps her hand on her sword.

column15: {=ARM_KR_064_2_U}On the Quiet Isle at the mouth of the Trident the brothers keep a vow of silence and tend the dead the river brings them. The Elder Brother tells Brienne gently that the Hound is dead: he found the man dying on the riverbank and buried him with his own hands.
column16: {=ARM_KR_064_2_L}Walking back to the ferry, Brienne passes a huge novice digging graves on the hillside, limping on a bad leg, his face hidden in his hood. A black stallion that kicks at everyone is kept in the stables. She does not look twice.

column15: {=ARM_KR_064_2a_U}On the Quiet Isle at the mouth of the Trident the brothers keep a vow of silence and tend the dead the river brings them. Brienne asks the Elder Brother about the Hound, and he tells her that a big scarred man still haunts the river roads.
column16: {=ARM_KR_064_2a_L}Find him and you may find the girl, the Elder Brother says, or a grave. Brienne rests a night among the silent brothers, then rides on toward the crossroads, more uneasy than before.

column15: {=ARM_KR_064_3_U}At the crossroads inn Brienne finds orphans keeping house and a young smith at the forge. Then riders come down the road, the last of the Brave Companions, led by a brute in the Hound's snarling helm, and the children scatter.
column16: {=ARM_KR_064_3_L}Brienne fights him in the mud and kills him, but his companion gets his teeth into her face before he dies. She lies in a fever among the orphans, and when she wakes, men of the Brotherhood without Banners are waiting.

column1: # 065 Davos w Bialym Porcie. Po oknie ROT o Stannisie; Stannis, Davos i lord Wyman zyja, Bialy Port u Manderlych. Davos (glowa rodu Seaworth)
# bez ukrycia - wyprawa na Skagos tylko w tekscie. Relacje w sekrecie, bez zmiany stron (Bitwa Bekartow ROT). Wariant a: Wendel zginal (ksiazka).

column15: {=ARM_KR_065_1_U}King Stannis sends Ser Davos Seaworth to White Harbor to win Lord Wyman Manderly. In the merman's court the enormous lord hears him with Frey guests at his side, then rages at the onion knight for offering treason and has him dragged off to the cells.
column16: {=ARM_KR_065_1_L}A few days later a head and a pair of hands are nailed above the Seal Gate, tarred black, with an onion in the mouth. The Freys are pleased and the Boltons write to thank Lord Wyman. Few men look closely at the face.

column15: {=ARM_KR_065_2_U}Far below the castle, Davos is alive. Lord Wyman comes to him in secret and drops the mask. The North has not forgotten, he says: men of White Harbor were butchered at the Red Wedding under guest right, and he smiles at Freys only to keep his kin alive.
column16: {=ARM_KR_065_2_L}He will not rise for Stannis yet. First he wants something only a smuggler can find: Rickon Stark, said to be hiding on the wild isle of Skagos with a wildling woman. Davos is to sail there in secret.

column15: {=ARM_KR_065_2a_U}Far below the castle, Davos is alive. Lord Wyman comes to him in secret and drops the mask. The North has not forgotten, he says: his son Wendel was murdered at the Red Wedding under guest right, and he smiles at Freys only to keep his other kin alive.
column16: {=ARM_KR_065_2a_L}He will not rise for Stannis yet. First he wants something only a smuggler can find: Rickon Stark, said to be hiding on the wild isle of Skagos with a wildling woman. Davos is to sail there in secret.

column15: {=ARM_KR_066_1_U}A cold rider with black hands guides Bran Stark, the Reeds and Hodor through the haunted forest to a hill crowned by a great weirwood. Beneath it lies a cave of roots and bones, where small brown folk who sing in a forgotten tongue take them in.
column16: {=ARM_KR_066_1_L}Deep inside, an ancient man sits woven into the roots, one red eye open. He is the three-eyed crow of Bran's dreams. Bran will never walk again, he says, but he will fly, and see through every weirwood in the world.

column15: {=ARM_KR_066_1a_U}Northern lords still seal their letters in the name of young Lord Bran Stark, but the boy himself is far beyond the Wall. A cold rider with black hands has guided him and his companions to a hill crowned by a great weirwood and a cave of roots beneath it.
column16: {=ARM_KR_066_1a_L}Deep inside, an ancient man sits woven into the roots, one red eye open. He is the three-eyed crow of Bran's dreams. Bran will never walk again, he says, but he will fly, and see through every weirwood in the world.

column15: {=ARM_KR_066_2_U}In the cave beneath the hill Bran closes his eyes and opens the red eyes of the heart trees. He sees snow falling on {PLACE} and armed men moving across {LAND}, small as ants, and he cannot warn any of them.
column16: {=ARM_KR_066_2_L}The three-eyed crow tells him that time is a river and a greenseer only watches it flow. Bran wakes with the taste of weirwood paste on his tongue and the cold of those far places still in his bones.

column1: # 067 Euron nad Manderem i rog smoka (nr 22 z listy 30). Po 042.1 (K4), gdy rzadzi Euron. Bez formalnej wojny: banda Zelaznych przy ujsciu
# Manderu, ludzie wsi do puli regionu (pop), relacje Reach-Wyspy. 067.2: Victarion plynie na wschod - tekst i relacje (bez ukrycia).

column15: {=ARM_KR_067_1_U}The Iron Fleet sails south under King Euron Greyjoy and falls upon the Shield Islands at the mouth of the Mander. Ironborn captains are made lords of rocks once held by Reach knights, and longships row upriver, burning villages within sight of Highgarden.
column16: {=ARM_KR_067_1_L}There is no declared war, only fire and plunder. Reach lords strip their coasts of men to guard their own walls, and the river folk flee inland with what they can carry. Ironborn reavers prowl the banks near Mandermouth.

column2: {=ARM_KR_067_1_W}News from the Reach: ironborn longships have seized the Shield Islands and are burning villages along the Mander.

column16: gora

column15: {=ARM_KR_067_2_U}Euron Greyjoy gives his brother Victarion command of the Iron Fleet and a great black horn banded with red gold and Valyrian glyphs. Blown by a strong man, Euron says, it will bind dragons to its master, though it burns the one who sounds it.
column16: {=ARM_KR_067_2_L}Victarion is to sail to Slaver's Bay, find Daenerys Targaryen and bring her back as Euron's bride. He sails east, hating his brother, with every warship he can man, and the raids along the Mander grow fewer.

column2: {=ARM_KR_067_2_W}Sailors say the Iron Fleet has gone east under Victarion Greyjoy, bound for Slaver's Bay and the dragon queen.

column15: {=ARM_KR_068_1_U}Tyrion Lannister crawls out of a wine cask in the manse of Magister Illyrio Mopatis, a vast perfumed merchant prince of Pentos and an old friend of Varys. Illyrio feeds him, keeps his cup full and listens to him talk about killing his father.
column16: {=ARM_KR_068_1_L}Then the magister makes an offer. There is a cause in the east worth serving, he says, a Targaryen cause, and a dwarf with a clever tongue might be useful to it. Tyrion has nothing better to do than live, so he agrees to go.

column2: {=ARM_KR_068_1_W}Merchants from Pentos say a dwarf with a Lannister face was a guest in Magister Illyrio's manse, and has since gone up the Rhoyne.

column15: tytul
column16: gora

column15: {=ARM_KR_068_2_U}Illyrio sends Tyrion up the Rhoyne on a poleboat with a grim sellsword called Griff and his blue-haired son. On the misty river Tyrion learns the truth: Griff is Jon Connington, once Hand of the King, and the boy is said to be Aegon Targaryen, Rhaegar's son.
column16: {=ARM_KR_068_2_L}Over games of cyvasse Tyrion needles the prince. Why go east to beg a girl for her dragons? Land in Westeros now, raise the dragon banners and let her come to him. Aegon listens. Jon Connington hides a greying finger in his glove.

column2: {=ARM_KR_068_2_W}River traders on the Rhoyne tell of a sellsword called Griff, a blue-haired youth he calls his son, and a dwarf who travels with them.

column15: {=ARM_KR_069_1_U}Lord Commander Jon Snow strikes the hardest bargain the Watch has ever made. Tormund Giantsbane and his people may pass the Wall and settle the empty castles along it, if they give up their gold and arm rings and send their sons as hostages.
column16: {=ARM_KR_069_1_L}Thousands of free folk come through the gate beneath the ice with carts, children and a giant or two. Many black brothers who fought them at the Wall mutter in the dark that the bastard has sold the realm to the wildlings.

column2: {=ARM_KR_069_1_W}Word from the Wall: the Lord Commander has let Tormund Giantsbane and thousands of free folk pass south through the Wall.

column15: tytul
column16: gora

column15: {=ARM_KR_069_2_U}At Hardhome, on the cold coast beyond the Wall, thousands of free folk wait for rescue, eating their dogs and then worse. The Lord Commander sends ships from Eastwatch, but a storm smashes half of them on the rocks, and the survivors write of the dead.
column16: {=ARM_KR_069_2_L}Dead things wait in the black woods around the town, they write, and wildlings who die in the night do not stay dead. Every boat that reaches the shore is swamped by desperate people. Jon begins to think of riding there himself.
column18: {=ARM_KR_069_2_Q}The Watch has few ships and little food. What do you do?

column2: {=ARM_KR_069_2_W}Ravens from Eastwatch: ships sent to save the free folk at Hardhome were wrecked in a storm, and the dead walk in the woods there.

column4: {=ARM_KR_069_2_Ha}You get a task: bring 120 fish to Hardhome within 60 days. The Watch and Tormund's people will remember it.

column3: {=ARM_KR_069_2_Cb}Send coin to Castle Black for ships
column4: {=ARM_KR_069_2_Hb}You pay 500 denars to the Lord Commander of the Watch. The Night's Watch thinks better of you.

column3: {=ARM_KR_069_2_Cc}Leave the free folk to their fate
column4: {=ARM_KR_069_2_Hc}As in the books: the rescue fails, and Hardhome waits for Jon Snow.

column9: {=ARM_KR_t069_D}The free folk trapped at Hardhome are starving. Bring 120 fish to Hardhome within 60 days, before the winter and the dead close in.

# bez zmiany krolestwa rodu i bez rozejmu (rozejm tylko pelna). 070.2 prowadzi do 047.2 (K4: kr:070.2+5). Wariant a: Brienne nie zyje.

column15: {=ARM_KR_070_1_U}A raven finds Ser Jaime Lannister in his camp in the Riverlands with a letter from his sister. Cersei writes in her own hand, blotted and hurried: enemies close in on her in King's Landing, she has never been in such danger, and he must ride to her at once.
column16: {=ARM_KR_070_1_L}Jaime reads it twice. Then he hands it to his squire and tells him to put it in the fire. He watches the parchment curl and blacken, and for the first time in his life he feels free of her.

column15: {=ARM_KR_070_2_U}Raventree Hall still holds out for the river lords, though the siege has dragged on for months. Jaime Lannister rides to the gate alone and talks with Lord Tytos Blackwood beneath the great dead weirwood where the ravens roost, instead of storming the walls.
column16: {=ARM_KR_070_2_L}Tytos yields on honourable terms and gives his son Hoster as a hostage. As Jaime leaves, a tall woman in battered armour rides into his camp. Brienne of Tarth says she has found Sansa Stark, and that Jaime must come with her.

column15: {=ARM_KR_070_2a_U}Raventree Hall still holds out for the river lords, though the siege has dragged on for months. Jaime Lannister rides to the gate alone and talks with Lord Tytos Blackwood beneath the great dead weirwood where the ravens roost, instead of storming the walls.
column16: {=ARM_KR_070_2a_L}Tytos yields on honourable terms and gives his son Hoster as a hostage. The war in the Riverlands is nearly done, and Jaime finds he has grown better at ending sieges than at starting them.

column1: # 071 Alys Karstark na Murze. Po egzekucji Karstarka z ROT. Rozstrzygniecie domyslne (rozdz. 16 pkt 9): rod Karstarkow bez przenosin, tylko
# relacje ze Stannisem; Alys przechodzi do Thennow (rod Styra Magnara clan_sturgia_5). Sigorn nie istnieje w ROT - w tekscie Magnar of Thenn.

column15: {=ARM_KR_071_1_U}A girl on a lathered horse gallops up to Castle Black with a handful of sworn men behind her. Alys Karstark has fled Karhold: now that her father is dead, her uncles mean to marry her to an old cousin and take her inheritance for themselves.
column16: {=ARM_KR_071_1_L}She asks the Lord Commander for shelter. She also brings word that old Arnolf Karstark, who marches with King Stannis, is secretly in league with the Boltons and means to betray the king at the worst moment.

column2: {=ARM_KR_071_1_W}Alys Karstark has fled Karhold and sought shelter at Castle Black with the Lord Commander of the Night's Watch.

column15: tytul
column16: gora

column15: {=ARM_KR_071_2_U}To keep Karhold out of her uncles' hands, Jon Snow gives Alys Karstark in marriage to the Magnar of Thenn, strongest of the free folk chiefs who came through the Wall. The wedding is held in the yard of Castle Black before a great fire.
column16: {=ARM_KR_071_2_L}Lady Melisandre speaks the words, Queen Selyse looks on with sour approval, and the black brothers watch a highborn northern girl wed a wildling. Alys takes her place among the Thenns, a bridge between two peoples.

column2: {=ARM_KR_071_2_W}At Castle Black, Alys Karstark has been wed to the Magnar of Thenn before the fire of a red priestess.

column15: {=ARM_KR_072_1_U}Snow falls on the godswood of Winterfell as Ramsay Bolton takes a bride before the heart tree. She is presented to the North as Arya Stark, though she is only a frightened steward's daughter in a grey dress, and the man who gives her away is Reek.
column16: {=ARM_KR_072_1_L}The northern lords gathered for the feast know better than to speak. Ramsay's claim to the North is sealed with a lie, and through the walls the castle hears the bride weeping in the night.

column15: {=ARM_KR_072_2_U}Snow buries Winterfell, and in the crowded castle men begin to die: a Frey boy found dead in the snow, a Bolton soldier with his throat opened, horses slaughtered in the night. At the feast fat Lord Wyman Manderly presents three huge pork pies and eats more than anyone.
column16: {=ARM_KR_072_2_L}Three Frey guests who rode north with Lord Wyman never arrived, and nobody asks too loudly where they went. Boltons and Freys eye each other across the hall, and the garrison sleeps with its swords.

column15: {=ARM_KR_072_3_U}Washerwomen who are not what they seem come to Winterfell with a singer called Abel. In the confusion of a snowstorm they get Reek and the grey bride out of Ramsay's chambers and up onto the outer wall, with Bolton men shouting below.
column16: {=ARM_KR_072_3_L}Theon takes the girl in his arms and jumps. They fall into deep drifts, crawl away through the snow and are found by scouts of King Stannis, whose host lies trapped in a blizzard a few days from the castle.

column15: {=ARM_KR_072_3a_U}Washerwomen who are not what they seem come to Winterfell with a singer called Abel. In the confusion of a snowstorm they get Reek and the grey bride out of Ramsay's chambers and up onto the outer wall, with Bolton men shouting below.
column16: {=ARM_KR_072_3a_L}Theon takes the girl in his arms and jumps. They fall into deep drifts and crawl away into the white wilderness, two broken people with nowhere to go and the hounds of the Dreadfort baying behind them.
